payload.name: Subroutine
payload.description: Begins another set of AoEs. The boss's floating node (Elimbit) will converge lasers near the north/south wall, indicating a donut AoE (Halo of Destruction). Meanwhile, the boss will cast another Partition, leaving only half of the middle of the donut safe. After the AoEs resolve, each player is given a spread AoE marker (Electray) that deals magical damage and inflicts lightning resistance down Lightning Resistance Down II, making overlap lethal.

payload.name: Subroutine
payload.description: The boss becomes untargetable and summons six Lightning Generators that need to be killed before the Charge gauge reaches 100. During this sequence, players will need to dodge donut AoEs from the Elimbit and line AoEs from the Elimination Claw which have the same indicators as before. Later on, the Elimbit will reappear and use a telegraphed line AoE (Light of Salvation) hitting all players, so the party should spread. There will be another line stack marker as well although it is possible to skip this with enough DPS.
